explanation: The AI response failed to provide the final filtered list of airports meeting all criteria because it claimed it could not access the 2023 ranking data. Instead, it provided a table with all airports and listed several airports outside the required target conditions (both in percentage and rank criteria). Matching the expected set: JFK, LGA, IAH, LAX, BNA, MDW, DEN, PHX are included in the response's table, but excessive extra airports (ATL, MSP, DTW, SEA, BWI, ORD, DCA, CLT, LAS, PHL, EWR, BOS, AUS, MIA, SAN, MCO, DFW, TPA, FLL, SFO) are also listed without performing the required year-over-year rank improvement filtering.
